title: Paid Antonym PART - (II) SSC CGL PRE 2024

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in bold.
His mother never held a grudge against his father
questions.solution:
A)Grudge(noun) – A persistent feeling of ill will or resentment resulting from a past insult or injury. द्वेष
Antonym:Benevolence(noun) – The quality of being well-meaning, kindness, goodwill. दयालुता

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Barbarity
questions.solution:
C) Barbarity(noun) means extreme cruelty or brutality, savagery, inhumanity. क्रूरता
Antonym:Compassion (noun) –Sympathy and concern for the sufferings or misfortunes of others; kindness, humanity. दया, करुणा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
An elephant is a large mammal
questions.solution:
C) Large(adjective) – Of considerable size, big, huge, gigantic. बड़ा
Antonym:Tiny(adjective) – Extremely small in size, miniature, minute. बहुत छोटा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Epitome
questions.solution:
A)Epitome(noun) – A perfect example, embodiment, personification, or model of a particular quality or type. प्रतिमान
Antonym:Expansion(noun) – The action of becoming larger or more extensive, extension, increase, enlargement. विस्तार
Precise(adjective) – Exact, accurate, clear-cut, specific. सटीक
Exhort(verb) – To strongly encourage or urge someone to do something, press, persuade. प्रोत्साहित करना
Lucid(adjective) – Clear, easy to understand, transparent, intelligible. सुस्पष्ट
Note:In this context, epitome represents something that is a condensed or perfect example, while expansion refers to making something larger or more extensive, which is conceptually opposite to a perfect, concise example

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in bold to fill in the blank.
The modern work is deliberately ________ (ambiguous).
questions.solution:
A)Ambiguous(adjective) – Open to more than one interpretation; not having one obvious meaning, unclear, doubtful. अस्पष्ट
Antonym: Certain(adjective) – known for sure, definite, clear. निश्चित, स्पष्ट
Dubious(adjective) – Hesitating or doubting, uncertain, questionable. संदिग्ध
Vague(adjective) – Not clear, not definite, imprecise, uncertain. अस्पष्ट
Puzzling(adjective) – Causing confusion, baffling, perplexing. उलझन भरा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
I was happy to know that Sheila passed her final exams
questions.solution:
B)Happy(adjective) – Feeling or showing pleasure or contentment, delighted, cheerful. खुश
Antonym:Sad(adjective) – Feeling or showing sorrow; unhappy, sorrowful, despondent. दुखी
Upbeat(adjective) – Cheerful, optimistic, lively, positive. आशावादी
Excited(adjective) – Enthusiastic, thrilled, eager, elated. उत्साहित
Joyful(adjective) – Full of happiness, jubilant, merry, delighted. प्रसन्न

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.
Sheila ________ (failed) all her classes
questions.solution:
D)Failed (verb)– To be unsuccessful in achieving something; to not succeed. असफल होना
Antonym:Passed (verb)– To succeed in an examination, course, or test. उत्तीर्ण होना
•Fizzled(verb) – To end or fail in a weak or disappointing way. असफल होना
•Flopped(verb) – To fail completely, especially in a performance or project. बुरी तरह असफल होना
•Flunked(verb) – To fail, especially in a test or class. फेल होना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in the brackets to fill in the blank.
She ________ the target by an inch and lost the gold medal. [hit]
questions.solution:
B) Hit(verb) – To come into contact with something forcefully or to succeed in reaching a target. प्रहार करना, निशाना लगाना
Antonym: Missed(verb) – To fail to hit, reach, or come into contact with something aimed at. चूकना
Cleaned(verb) – To remove dirt or impurities. साफ करना
Bashed(verb) – To strike or hit hard. जोर से मारना
Touched(verb) – To make physical contact with. स्पर्श करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word.
If someone babbles, it means that they talk in a confused or excited way.
questions.solution:
C)Babble(verb) – Talk rapidly and continuously in a foolish, excited, or incomprehensible way, prattle, jabber. बड़बड़ाना
Antonym:Quiet(adjective) – Making little or no noise, silent, calm, still.शांत
Rants(verb) – Speak or shout at length in a wild, impassioned way. गुस्से में चिल्लाना
Talkative(adjective) – Fond of talking, chatty, garrulous, loquacious. बातूनी
Gossips(verb) – Engage in casual or unconstrained conversation, often involving details about other people's private lives. गपशप करना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in the brackets to fill in the blank.
Akash went to ______ his school uniform. [sell]
questions.solution:
D)Sell(verb) – To exchange something for money. बेचना
Antonym:Buy(verb) – To acquire something by paying for it; purchase. ख़रीदना
Make(verb) – To create or produce something. बनाना
Rent(verb) – To pay for the use of something for a period of time. किराए पर लेना
Loan(verb) – To lend something to someone for a temporary period. उधार देना

questions.question:
Choose the most appropriate ANTONYM for the underlined word in the given sentence.
The war was followed by a long period of prosperity
questions.solution:
D)Prosperity(noun) – The state of being successful, thriving, or flourishing, especially in financial or material terms. समृद्धि
Antonym:Failure(noun) – Lack of success, collapse, or downfall. असफलता
Affluence(noun) – Abundance of wealth or material goods. समृद्धि
Security(noun) – The state of being free from danger or threat. सुरक्षा
Secure(adjective) – Fixed or fastened so as not to give way; protected against threats. सुरक्षित

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Affirmative
questions.solution:
C)Affirmative(adjective) – Agreeing or consenting, positive, approving, favorable. सकारात्मक
Antonym:Negative(adjective) – Opposing or refusing, not positive, disapproving, unfavorable. नकारात्मक
Accession(noun) – The act of attaining a position or right, induction, elevation. सिंहासन पर बैठना
Sanction(noun) – A threatened penalty for disobeying a law or rule, approval, ratification. प्रतिबंध/अनुमोदन
Acquiescence(noun) – The reluctant acceptance of something without protest, compliance, submission. स्वीकृति

questions.question:
Identity the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Secure
questions.solution:
D)Secure(adjective) – Safe, protected, free from danger or harm. सुरक्षित
Antonym:Attack(verb) – To take aggressive action against, to assault, to harm. आक्रमण करना
Trundle(verb) – Move slowly and heavily, typically in a noisy or uneven way. धीरे-धीरे चलना
Save(verb) – To rescue or preserve from harm or danger. बचाना
Succeed(verb) – To achieve the desired aim or result. सफल होना

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Receive
questions.solution:
C)Receive(verb) – To get, accept, or acquire something, to take delivery of. प्राप्त करना
Antonym:Exile(verb) – To banish or send someone away from their home or country, to exclude from a group. निर्वासित करना
Reward(noun) – Something given in recognition of service, effort, or achievement. पुरस्कार
Admit(verb) – To allow someone to enter, to accept as valid or true. स्वीकार करना
Fund(noun) – A sum of money saved or made available for a particular purpose. निधि

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the word in brackets to fill in the blank.
She has _______ (witty) remarks about everything
questions.solution:
B)Witty(adjective) – Showing or characterized by quick and inventive verbal humor. चतुराई भरे, मजेदार
Antonym:Unamusing(adjective) – Not amusing, not entertaining, boring. नीरस
Whimsical(adjective) – Playfully quaint or fanciful, especially in an appealing and amusing way. अजीबोगरीब
Woeful(adjective) – Characterized by sorrow, misery, or wretchedness. दुःखद
Sorry(adjective) – Feeling regret, remorse, or penitence. खेदजनक

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Paralysed
questions.solution:
B)Paralysed(adjective) – Unable to move or act, immobile, inactive. अचल/ लकवाग्रस्त
Antonym:Healthy(adjective) – Physically strong and well, having good health, able to function normally. स्वस्थ
Demure(adjective) – Modest, shy, reserved, timid. शर्मीला/ शान्त
Stifled(adjective) – Suppressed, restrained, suffocated. दबा हुआ
Sultry(adjective) – Hot and humid, oppressively warm. उमस भरा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Catastrophe
questions.solution:
A)Catastrophe(noun) – A sudden and widespread disaster, calamity, tragedy. विनाश
Antonym:Success(noun) – The accomplishment of an aim or purpose, achievement, triumph. सफलता
Nurture(verb) – Care for and encourage the growth or development of, cultivate, foster. पालन-पोषण
Immaculate(adjective) – Perfectly clean, neat, or tidy, spotless, flawless. निर्मल/ श्रेष्ठ
Disaster(noun) – A sudden event, such as an accident or a natural catastrophe, that causes great damage or loss of life, calamity, tragedy. आपदा

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the underlined word in the given sentence.
One must be very strong to lift this box of glass jars
questions.solution:
B)Strong(adjective) – Having great physical power or strength, robust, powerful, sturdy.शक्तिशाली, बलवान
Antonym:Weak(adjective) – Lacking physical strength or power, feeble, frail, delicate.कमजोर, निर्बल
Mighty(adjective) – Possessing great and impressive power or strength, powerful, formidable. शक्तिमान
Complicated(adjective) – Consisting of many interconnecting parts, intricate, complex.जटिल
Rugged(adjective) – Having a rough, uneven surface; sturdy or strong.कठोर, सख्त

questions.question:
Select the most appropriate ANTONYM of the given word.
Monotonous
questions.solution:
C)Monotonous(adjective) – Lacking in variety and interest, dull, repetitive. नीरस
Antonym:Engrossing(adjective) – Absorbing all one's attention or interest, captivating, interesting. मनमोहक
Tiresome(adjective) – Causing one to feel bored or annoyed, tiring, dull. थकाऊ
Tedious(adjective) – Too long, slow, or boring; monotonous, repetitive. उबाऊ
Rational(adjective) – Based on reason or logic, sensible, logical. तार्किक

questions.question:
Select the word OPPOSITE in meaning to the underlined word in the given sentence.
Feeling discouraged, she finally finds the motivation for pursing her goal.
questions.solution:
C)Discouraged(adjective) – Lacking confidence or enthusiasm, feeling disheartened or deterred. उत्साहहीन
Antonym:Inspired(adjective) – Filled with the urge to do something creative, motivated, encouraged. प्रेरित
Disappointed(adjective) – Feeling let down, dissatisfied, or frustrated. निराश
Admired(adjective) – Regarded with respect or approval. प्रशंसित
Energetic(adjective) – Having or showing a lot of energy, active, dynamic. ऊर्जावान
